reads.note: Clarion curves down from the top (label CLARION at ~8200,6150) and turns south-east as 'AVE.' (nos. 3613-3639) to meet Montgomery. The west-leg centreline meets Montgomery's centreline at ~(8824, 6725): its north edge corner is (8795,6667) and it is ~75 px wide. On the east side a short horizontal stub labelled 'CL' (edges y~6607/6680, centre ~6643) meets Montgomery's centreline at ~(8869, 6643), then runs off the plate. So the crossing is jogged. I reported the midpoint. Montgomery is ~105 px wide here (west edge ~8770, east edge ~8890 near y 6700). East of Montgomery the plate is blank below the stub.

Jogged crossing: west arm 'AVE.' (50 ft, slanting WNW, centreline would hit Montgomery centreline ~8831,6719) and east stub 'CL..' (horizontal, centre y~6640, meets road centre ~8876,6640) are offset ~70 px along Montgomery. Took middle of the open area on Montgomery centreline between the two mouths. The curved street labelled CLARION further west (x~8230) is the same avenue's continuation and does not meet Montgomery again.

note: Both reads took the middle of the Clarion jog (west arm and east stub meet Montgomery about 70-80 px apart). The old pick is the west arm.
